The season began on 5 February and ended on 5 December 2021. The fixtures for the season were announced on 15 January 2021.{{cite web|url=http://www.tigosports.com.py/copa-de-primera/campeonato-apertura-2021-inicio-sistema-menos-clubes|title=Vuelve el apasionante todos contra todos para el Apertura 2021|language=Spanish|publisher=Tigo Sports|date=5 January 2021|access-date=11 January 2021}}{{cite web|url=http://www.tigosports.com.py/copa-de-primera/ya-se-conoce-el-calendario-del-torneo-apertura-2021|title=Ya se conoce el calendario del torneo Apertura 2021|language=Spanish|publisher=Tigo Sports|date=15 January 2021|access-date=28 January 2021}} [[Club Olimpia|Olimpia]] were the defending champions after winning the [[2020 Paraguayan Primera División season#Torneo Clausura|2020 Clausura]] tournament. In the Torneo Apertura, [[Club Libertad|Libertad]] secured their twenty-first league title with one match to spare following [[Club Nacional|Nacional]]'s loss to [[Club River Plate (Asunción)|River Plate]] on 23 May,{{cite web|url=https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/libertad/2021/05/23/libertad-campeon/|title=¡Libertad Campeón!|publisher=ABC Color|date=23 May 2021}} whilst in the Torneo Clausura [[Cerro Porteño]] won their thirty-fourth league title after drawing with eventual runners-up [[Club Guaraní|Guaraní]] 2–2 on the last matchday played on 4 December.{{cite web |url=https://www.abc.com.py/deportes/futbol/2021/12/04/guarani-vs-cerro-porteno-a-lo-ciclon-cerro-porteno-es-el-campeon-del-clausura/|title=Guaraní vs. Cerro Porteño: A lo Ciclón, Cerro Porteño es el campeón del Clausura|language=es|publisher=ABC Color|date=4 December 2021|access-date=5 December 2021}} ==Teams== Ten teams competed in the season: the top ten teams in the relegation table of the previous season, with no teams promoted from the [[Paraguayan División Intermedia|División Intermedia]] since the 2020 seasons of the lower-tier club tournaments of Paraguayan football were cancelled by the [[Paraguayan Football Association]] due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Paraguay|COVID-19 pandemic]].{{cite web|url=https://versus.lanacion.com.py/versus/2020/09/11/es-oficial-apf-suspende-intermedia-y-6-torneos-mas/|title=Es oficial: ¡APF suspende Intermedia y 6 torneos más!|publisher=Versus|date=11 September 2020|access-date=11 January 2021}} [[Club General Díaz (Luque)|General Díaz]] and [[Club Sportivo San Lorenzo|San Lorenzo]] were both relegated to the second tier at the end of the previous ==Relegation== Relegation is determined at the end of the season by computing an average of the number of points earned per game over the past three seasons. The team with the lowest average was relegated to the [[Paraguayan División Intermedia|División Intermedia]] for the following season, while the team with the second lowest average played a double-legged relegation play-off against the [[2021 Paraguayan División Intermedia|2021 Intermedia]] fourth placed team.{{cite web|url=https://d10.ultimahora.com/panorama-completo-los-torneos-paraguayos-n2921104.html|title=Panorama completo de los torneos paraguayos|language=Spanish|publisher=D10 Paraguay|date=2 January 2021|access-date=11 January 2021}} ===Relegation table=== {| class="wikitable" style="text-align:center" !width=28| Pos
